newsitem.title: USA: Energy Group to sell Citizens Power assets.
newsitem.headline: Energy Group to sell Citizens Power assets.

text.p: British power company Energy Group Plc said Thursday that it has an agreement to sell the assets of Citizen Power which are subject to jurisdiction under the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc.
Citizens Power LLC is a subsidiary of Energy Group Plc. The Citizens Power assets included in the sale are the only assets owned by Energy Group which are subject to FERC jurisdiction.
Energy Group also said its directors have recommended acceptance of a multi-billion dollar cash tender offer for the company from U.S.-based PacifiCorp.

Last month, PacifiCorp offered to buy Energy Group Plc for about $11.35 per share (6.96 sterling) in a deal that would create one of the world's biggest energy companies as the British market prepares for deregulation in 1998.
The sale of the jurisdictional assets is subject to PacifiCorp's successful completion of the tender offer for Energy Group's shares, according to Energy Group.
